Al Taza Special

A soft Rumali roti rolled with tender Lebanese-style chicken, crispy fries, creamy cheesy mayo, and tangy pickled veggies. Every bite blends rich flavor, juicy texture, and satisfying crunch, creating a bold shawarma experience crafted to deliver consistent taste and enjoyment.

₹230.00

Full Meat Shawarma

A generous filling of juicy sliced chicken and crispy golden fries wrapped in soft Rumali roti with creamy mayonnaise and tangy pickled veggies. This shawarma blends tenderness & crunch, delivering a richly satisfying bite created to delight meat lovers everywhere.

₹200.00

Normal Chicken

It’s made with chicken that tastes so good, topped with lettuce, onions, and crispy fries, and served inside a soft and elastic Rumali Roti. It’s just so easy and mouth-watering at the same time. That’s why it’s perfect for people who seriously crave for a delicious shawarma.

₹155.00

Al Taza Jumbo Shawarma

Pizza Shawarma

A flavorful fusion shawarma filled with sliced chicken, melted mozzarella, creamy mayo, jalapeños, onions, and capsicum. Wrapped neatly in soft Rumali roti, it blends rich pizza flavors with classic shawarma taste, delivering a bold, cheesy, and satisfyingly indulgent bite every time.

₹285.00

Paneer Roll

₹200.00
